My dear [C C](/person/329)
The world seems wild with joy and flags from every window house! [Maurice](/person/1630) says traffic was stopped in London by people waving flags and shaking hands.[^1] I suppose there will be a culminating in a great illumination when it is over.

Well, I shall be very glad of you on the 15th I shall like to have the benefit of the lectures, but I am afraid [my young missionary](/book/250) is so far very dull.

Has[ Fanny Awdry](/person/82) written to you about their trouble [Mr Vere Awdry](/person/84)’s little [Bridget](/person/79) has died after two days illness, a very clever child of seven, and they have only the boy left[^2] He is such a depressed person that one is very sorry for the shock to him, and probably the good little homely [wife](/person/2214) is more grieved for him than herself
Do you know who does the [Church history answers](/organisation/211)- [Rosie](/person/418)’s two last have never been returned, she had 100 for one and 97 for the others of the two first and she is rather uneasy about these two last- She has 75 for the first on Henry V- [Cecily](/person/183) is to go to Dorking with her [Granny](/person/109) and she is in a desperate hurry to start They do not go till the 13th so I shall have only one solitary day-
Old Comrades’s lists of books amuse me, they are so entirely what they happen to have-
Pauline is a beautiful story.

You will come in for some sermons on the spiritual application of worldly maxims on Friday evenings by [Mr Lowth](/person/2215) of Colden Common.

We have had ‘All is not gold that glitters’ rather nice, but not loud enough
your affte

C M Yonge


[^1]: The news of Cronje\'s surrender had caused these celebrations.
[^2]: Bridget Hildred Vere Awdry (7 November 1892-23 February 1900) was the daughter of the Rev Vere Awdry (1854-1928) and his second wife Mary Louisa Man (d.1908). ‘The boy’ was killed in 1914.

By his third wife the Rev.

Vere Awdry was the father of the Rev.

Wilbert Vere Awdry (1911-1997), the author of Thomas the Tank Engine (1946) and other works.
